## Recall · Lectures 3, 5, 6, 7 and 12

a) A phone is hot after 15 minutes and the game slows down. What is it?
b) Where do you check what a new OS version changes for games?
c) A forum post says "the game runs twice as fast after the update". What is it?

::: {.answer}
a) thermal throttling
b) the official release notes
c) a claim to check
:::

## Activity 1 · Read the frames · 15 min

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- The time of one frame is 1000 ms divided by the frame rate.
- One frame that is much longer than the others is a stutter, and the player sees a jerk.
- **Do it:** Find the frame times at 30 and 60 fps. What does one 70 ms frame do in a 60 fps race? Then play Performance Detective.
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/frame-times.png)
:::
::::

## Check 1 · Read the frames

What do the frame times and the hot phone show?

::: {.reveal}
1. One frame takes about 33.3 ms at 30 fps and 16.7 ms at 60 fps.
2. A frame of 70 ms takes more than four normal frames, so the player sees a stutter.
3. The hot phone slows down because of thermal throttling.
4. A frame-rate cap of 30 fps or lower settings keep the game steady.
:::

## Activity 2 · Make every row green · 15 min

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Build 43 needs Android 11, but one test phone has Android 8.
- One old GPU has no Vulkan, and a 4:3 tablet cuts off the Start button.
- **Do it:** Make every row green in Compatibility Lab and write what each fix costs. Which source about the update do you trust?

{{< sim file="sims/compat-lab.html" poster="sims/compat-lab.png" title="Compatibility Lab: build 43 for every device" task="**Show:** change the minimum version, add a second graphics path and anchor the menu. **Ask:** why does every fix cost more testing?" >}}

## Check 2 · Make every row green

How does build 43 run on every device?

::: {.reveal}
1. The minimum version goes down to Android 8, so the team tests Android 8 too.
2. A second graphics path (OpenGL ES) is one more path to test.
3. The menu is anchored to the safe area, so every screen shape needs a check.
4. The release notes are the reliable source, and the team tests the update itself.
:::

## Wrap-up

- You can read frame times and explain a stutter and a hot phone.
- You can make one build work on many devices and say what it costs.
- You can check a claim about a platform with a reliable source.
